contexts.text: The pulse of those who are of the province of the occiput.

These Spirits... are seated at the hinder part of the head beneath the cerebellum to the left; for those who act beneath the occiput operate more clandestinely than others; and those who act at the back part desire to command.

A thundering murmur which flowed down from on high above the occiput... It was those who relate to the general involuntary sense... Their manifest operation into all the province of the occiput. (Continued. See Cerebellum.) SE 3860.
Those who appear beneath the occiput are those who act tacitly and prudently.
A multitude of Spirits consociated with (the Spirits of Mercury)... in the plane of the occiput.
At this day there is a region behind the occiput occupied by the evil.
This (chiding) Spirit stood at the occiput...
No one is permitted in Heaven to stand behind another, and look at his occiput; for then the influx of good and truth from the Lord is disturbed.

The influx of the celestial Angels is into that part of the head beneath which is the cerebellum, and which is called the occiput; from the ears all round, even to the neck; for that region corresponds to wisdom.
Genii are seated with man beneath the occiput.
Some (Genii)... at once applied themselves to my neck beneath the occiput, and thence entered into my affections...
Then light descended from Heaven, which first illuminated their occiputs, and afterwards their temples...
Such look upwards with the occiput, and downwards with the forehead.

All the Angels of Hell turn the occiput to the Lord, and receive influx into the affections of their will, which in themselves are concupiscences, and cause the understanding to favour... For the human will dwells in the cerebellum, which is in the occiput.
The Spirit shook the torch at their occiputs, whence the ideas of them all became confused...
The radiance enlightened the temples of some on the side of the occiput, but not as yet on the side of the forehead...
Why the occiputs of those who have the delight of doing evil are hollowed out, there. Explained.
Infernal delight... inflows into every man; but into the soles of his feet, his back, and his occiput. If it is received in the forehead... the man is enslaved to Hell. Explained.
He was at my occiput: he spoke there, and that undulatingly.
He adheres to a man behind, beneath the occiput; and through him that crew acts... SE 1748, Described.
For those who as it were adhere to the occiput act more clandestinely than others.
He came in beneath the occiput... and when he was there, I perceived as it were a stroke through the heart, and afterwards in the brain...
They proceed in their cupidity... into the part of the occiput beneath the cerebellum...
They stand above... the occiput, where is the cerebellum...
They keep themselves beneath the occiput; both because they want to reign... and because they desire to act incognito...
Therefore robbers dwell beneath the occiput. SE 3871.
It was given to feel the pulsations of the heart in the occiput...
They feign that they adhere to the hairs which are on the occiput, beneath the cerebellum...
They send their Subjects under the occiput, where is the general sense...
(This magician from Hell) was placed at my occiput...
This place corresponds in place to the occiput.
(This witch) inhered in the place at the occiput, between the cerebrum and the cerebellum...
Those who are seated... almost beneath the occiput enter into man's speech...
Those who come to the hinder parts of man beneath the occiput rule the man's thoughts...
The evil Spirits with man... who are at his occiput inflow very much into the thought... in fact into the interior thought...
With those who think much against the neighbour, from deceit and from cunning, there are Genii at the occiput...

If a Spirit appears as is becoming as to the occiput, he is received. The reason is, that the face can counterfeit, but not the occiput; for the occiput is that into which inflow the affections which are of love; and therefore a Spirit appears openly as to his love in the occiput.

There are Spirits who know how to cheat others by turning their occiputs to a good Society... but if the same Spirit is turned round to their other side, so that he cannot turn the occiput to that Society, his quality appears.
Spirits are explored... especially by being turned round and by looking into the occiput; and if they are foul there, they know that they are of evil affection.
There are Spirits who relate to the general sense, and have their situation beneath the occiput...
These are the malignant who are beneath the occiput.
(A Spirit over the occiput who had imitated my father.)

The things which inflow from Heaven into the affection of man inflow into his occiput; and thus come into his manifest perception; for the things which enter into the affection are perceived manifestly...
The dragonists are explored... by looking into the occiput.
They act into the occiput, and thus enter into the thought.
